meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 选定的 NanoClaw agent 容器里会装上 dial 命令行和 dial-cli 技能,可以发短信、打 AI 语音电话、收验证码;没被选中的 agent 会在网关被拦截。
howto.when: 你想让某个 agent 直接从聊天里发短信、打电话或运行 dial 命令时使用;需在主机上的 NanoClaw 仓库运行,且已装好 OneCLI。

say.text: 运行 /add-dial-tool,让 ag-main 能用 Dial
say.note: 会装 CLI,并只给该 agent 注入密钥

say.text: /add-dial-tool,这次改成只有 ag-support 能用
say.note: 重复运行可改变哪些 agent 可用

say.text: /add-dial-tool,先装好但所有 agent 都别用
say.note: 工具装好,每个 agent 都被拦截

howto.what_en: On chosen NanoClaw agents the container gains the dial CLI and the dial-cli skill, so they can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and read verification codes; agents you leave out are blocked at the gateway.
howto.when_en: Use when you want an agent to text, call, or run dial commands from a chat. Run it on the host in the NanoClaw repo, not from an agent chat, with OneCLI installed.

say_en.text: Run /add-dial-tool and give Dial to ag-main only
say_en.note: Installs the CLI, injects the key for that agent only

say_en.text: /add-dial-tool — change it so only ag-support can use Dial
say_en.note: Re-running changes which agents may use Dial

say_en.text: /add-dial-tool, install the tool but let no agent use it yet
